description: Source code for localized string management in the starboard namespace, including functions for loading language-specific CSV files and retrieving localized strings.

classes.name: LocalizedStrings
classes.description: Class for managing localized strings loaded from language-specific CSV files.

methods.name: LocalizedStrings
methods.description: Constructor that loads strings for a specified language, with fallback to a generic language if needed.

methods.name: GetString
methods.description: Retrieve a localized string by ID, with a fallback if not found.

methods.name: GetMatchType
methods.description: Returns the match type indicating how the language was matched.

methods.name: LoadStrings
methods.description: Loads localized strings from a CSV file for a given language.

methods.name: LoadSingleString
methods.description: Parses a single key/value pair from a line in the CSV file.
